name: Helper roster stacks beside a live summary
looks: A headline with one cursive word lands, then a short stack of named helper cards fills in below it, each with a small two-letter badge, a role name and a one-line note on what it just did. A small summary message card pops up beneath the stack, timestamped, confirming one of the helpers' work in plain language.
build: script-accent-underline for the headline; list-stack-reveal for the helper cards, each landing bright without dimming the ones above since they are peers, not a countdown. The summary card fades/slides in last, after a short pause.
sound: A tick per helper card landing, and a soft confirm chime on the summary card.
prompt: Introduce a team of specialised helpers at once: stack three or four named roles in one after another, each with a short badge and a note on the task it just handled, then cap it with a plain-language summary message proving the work actually happened.
